summary: Documentary PR featurette celebrating the dedication of Kakrapar Atomic Power Station (KAPP-3 and KAPP-4) 700 MW PHWR units to the nation by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Includes plant exterior views, control room footage, historical archive reference to RAPP 1973, reactor interior details, safety systems, and interviews with AEC/NPCIL leadership.
